question_text: During lunch hours (12-14), did the food court get more crowded than the expo floor, or did people stay at the booths? Compare the average crowd sizes.
answer_text: During lunch hours, the Expo Floor was more crowded than the Food Court, with an average crowd size of 108.55 compared to 81.91. The Booth areas were the least crowded, with an average of 14.76.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T12:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T15:00:00Z'
    AND ch.camera_location CONTAINS 'FoodCourt'
  RETURN 'FoodCourt' AS location, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_crowd_size
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T12:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T15:00:00Z'
    AND ch.camera_location CONTAINS 'ExpoFloor'
  RETURN 'ExpoFloor' AS location, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_crowd_size
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T12:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T15:00:00Z'
    AND ch.camera_location CONTAINS 'Booth'
  RETURN 'Booth' AS location, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_crowd_size
}
RETURN location, avg_crowd_size ORDER BY avg_crowd_size DESC
